newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Prasidha rises on first coffee plant.
newsitem.headline: Prasidha rises on first coffee plant.

text.p: Shares of Indonesia's trading firm PT Prasidha Aneka Niaga rose sharply in early trading on the Jakarta stock exchange on Tuesday following a report that it would open its first instant and powdered coffee plant in March, brokers said.
Prasidha was among the most actively traded counters, with a volume close to 1.4 million shares. It rose 225 rupiah to 3,675 rupiah after 30 minutes of trading.
Prasidha told Reuters on Monday it planned to open its first instant and powdered coffee plant in Sidoarjo, East Java, in March.
The firm's corporate secretary Arief Petrus said the coffee plant marked the first move by the firm into production as it had traditionally been involved only in trading.
